question: Should Kova preserve the documented `<runId>-bundle.tar.gz` lookup contract, or intentionally introduce a breaking content-addressed filename contract?
rationale: The branch makes a deliberate reliability tradeoff that can break existing artifact consumers, and repository history does not establish an approved migration policy.

options.title: Preserve the stable path
options.body: Keep the immutable hash-addressed artifact while providing a safe stable lookup or manifest contract with compatibility tests.

options.title: Accept the breaking path
options.body: Adopt hash-only filenames with an explicit schema-version change, updated documentation, and upgrade evidence for affected automation.

recommendation.title: Preserve the stable path
recommendation.body: Keep the immutable hash-addressed artifact while providing a safe stable lookup or manifest contract with compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and currently own the artifact and report-path contracts affected by this choice.
